div.div: This Amendment No.1 to Schedule 13D (this "Amendment No.1") is filed to amend and supplement the Schedule 13D filed by AGHL, AZIL, Cainiao Investment and NRF with the Securities and Exchange Commission on June 21, 2018 (the "Original Schedule 13D"), with respect to ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. (the "Original Filing"). Except as specifically amended and supplemented by this Amendment No.1, the Original Filing remains in full force and effect. All capitalized terms contained herein but not otherwise defined shall have the meaning ascribed to such terms in the Original Filing.

td.div:
Item 2(a) of the Original Filing is hereby amended and restated as follows:
This Amendment No.1 constitutes a Schedule 13D filing on behalf of each of (1) Alibaba Group Holding Limited, (2) Alibaba ZT Investment Limited, (3) Cainiao Smart Logistics Investment Limited, (4) New Retail Strategic Opportunities Investments 2 Limited, (5) Taobao China Holding Limited, and (6) Cainiao Smart Logistics Network (Hong Kong) Limited (AGHL, AZIL, Cainiao Investment, NRF, TCHL and Cainiao Hong Kong are collectively referred to as the "Reporting Persons"), with respect to Class A Ordinary Shares. This Amendment No.1 is filed jointly by the Reporting Persons pursuant to Rule 13d-1(k) under the Exchange Act. The agreement among the Reporting Persons relating to the joint filing of this Amendment No.1 is attached hereto as Exhibit A.
The name of each executive officer and each member of the board of directors of each Reporting Person is set forth on Schedule A-1 hereto and is incorporated herein by reference.

Item 2(b) of the Original Filing is hereby amended and restated as follows:
The business address of AGHL, AZIL, NRF, TCHL and Cainiao HK is c/o Alibaba Group Services Limited, 26/F, Tower One, Times Square, 1 Matheson Street, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong. The business address of Cainiao Investment is c/o North Cainiao Post Station, No. 501 Fengxin Road, Yuhang District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province 310000, People's Republic of China.
The business address of each executive officer and each member of the board of directors of each Reporting Person is set forth on Schedule A-1 hereto and is incorporated herein by reference.

Item 2(c) of the Original Filing is hereby amended and restated as follows:
AGHL is a company incorporated in the Cayman Islands, with its American depositary shares, each representing eight ordinary shares, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (Stock Symbol: BABA), and its ordinary shares listed on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (Stock Code: 9988 (HKD Counter) and 89988 (RMB Counter)). AGHL is a holding company of businesses comprising Alibaba China E-commerce Group, Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group, AI + Cloud businesses, and others.
AZIL is an indirect wholly-owned special purpose subsidiary of AGHL.
Each of Cainiao Investment and Cainiao HK is wholly owned by Cainiao Smart Logistics Network Limited ("Cainiao Cayman"), a company incorporated under the laws of the Cayman Islands, which in turn is indirectly wholly owned by AGHL. Cainiao Investment principally engages in investment activities on behalf of Cainiao Cayman. Cainiao HK, together with Cainiao Cayman's other subsidiaries, operates e-commerce logistics business based on its smart logistics network and provides cross-border e-commerce logistics services globally.
New Retail Strategic Opportunities Fund, L.P., a Cayman Islands exempted limited partnership ("NRSF"), owns 100% of NRF. New Retail Strategic Opportunities Fund GP, L.P., a Cayman Islands exempted limited partnership ("NRSF GP"), is the general partner of NRSF. New Retail Strategic Opportunities GP Limited, a company organized under the laws of the Cayman Islands and an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of AGHL ("NRSO"), is the general partner of NRSF GP. Each of NRSF, NRSF GP and NRSO principally engages in investment activities.
TCHL is an indirectly wholly-owned subsidiary of AGHL and the direct holding company of certain PRC subsidiaries relating to Taobao Marketplace and Tmall.
The present principal occupation or employment of each executive officer and each member of the board of directors of each Reporting Person are set forth on Schedule A-1 hereto and are incorporated herein by reference.

Item 2(f) of the Original Filing is hereby amended and restated as follows:
Alibaba Group Holding Limited: Cayman Islands.
Alibaba ZT Investment Limited: Hong Kong.
Cainiao Investment: British Virgin Islands
New Retail Strategic Opportunities Investments 2 Limited: Cayman Islands.
TCHL: Hong Kong
Cainiao HK: Hong Kong
The citizenship of each executive officer and each member of the board of directors of each Reporting Person is set forth on Schedule A-1 hereto and is incorporated herein by reference.
